[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627366/3335e1870e92993d9e89f13aa4b7633f529aec30.png[/img]

We’re all super stoked to have these guys on board and in Session, we hope you’re going to enjoy thrashing with [b]Dane Burman[/b] and [b]Ribs Man[/b] or becoming a wizard like [b]Donovan Strain[/b]. 

[b]Welcome ZERO Skateboards[/b]

We are overly hyped to bring ZERO into the Session kingdom! 
Having Dane Burman in Session without ZERO is like watching a skate video muted… it’s just not the same. 

So now you have an awesome stock of ZERO products in your wardrobe! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627366/bc49f91a68af7247f551c38eef203f61de8e09d3.gif[/img]

You also got a healthy supply of new boards in that box that turned up at your apartment

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627366/361f2a0fca0f7c4df8433bf9de56df4ba2be4a7d.gif[/img]

There was a note in this hypothetical box we speak of, and it said: “These boards are for skating, NOT for your wall!”  

[b]Customization Brand Filter[/b]
You’ll now be able to filter your customization menu by brand, Only want a certain brand, from our ever-growing supply of companies? Simple fix, just push your RB button until you reach your desired brand. Gone too far? Another simple fix. Just push the LB to retrace your steps and select a different brand. 

[b]Fun things to do[/b]

We’ve added new challenges in the Brooklyn Banks and Pyramid Ledge areas 

We have also tidied up the experimental, games of skate to be more tender and tasty when playing with people via Steams Remote play feature. 

[b]Art fixes[/b]

Some fixes to the environment, assets and characters, can you spot the difference with this board?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627366/ce17883b6557bbf4baece263a6eeb6d7e5bcb609.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627366/f32513265329384a55b7477bb9391e60c71576e8.gif[/img]

[b]Level optimization[/b]
City lighting has had some love and some optimization and is now using the latest cool [b]Screen Space Global Illumination[/b] Feature from Unreal 4.24 and more work has been done for that frame rate of yours.

[b]Bug fixes & Misc[/b][list]
[*] We’ve done even more trick polishing in auto and manual catch settings
[*] Late Shuvs and flips are now faster
[*] Customization toolbars are now working.
[*] Our kickflip and Heelflip Speeds have been evened out
[*] The skaters overall speed has been reduced to work normally and in par with the new transition physics
[*] Lo pop from grinds has been reduced for extra steez
[*] High pop out of grinds has been augmented 
[*] (dev-wise refered as catch orient) has changed, allowing you to get more lifelike angles and better lock-ins
[*] The exit pop window has been shortened, meaning you will be more prompt to bail if you initiated your tricks AFTER you've left the ledge. (This helps reduce the late pop bug) 
[/list]

We’ve got a few nasty critters with this update, the biggest one is the “bank bounce bonk bug” where you would, (“would” being the main word here)  bounce down a bank on your nose or tail. This has been caught and is now serving a life sentence. 

Session now runs on unreal engine 4.24.3 

The contact shadow was creating visual artifacts so it got removed
The in-game sun trajectory is closer to a real-life trajectory.

[b]What’s up next?[/b]

As we're approaching our XBOX milestone, the upcoming months will be dedicated to polishing everything we built so far. Such as optimizing the city, working on the physics, polishing the tricks and so on. Meaning our effort will be put onto tightening up the whole experience and crushing those nasty bugs as much as possible for our next update.

From here at crea-ture studios, we want to thank everyone for the ongoing support, love and feedback and don’t forget to join us on our Discord server https://discord.gg/hrgBJPT! So that’s What’s up and what’s gone down since the last update. 
keep shredding and stay rad!

The crea-ture Team.

Just scoop round with your back foot stick and flick down with your front foot stick!

Late Flips and Shuvs!
 
Now your skater has learned late flips! Go into the ‘Flip Tricks Settings’ 
And turn them on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627366/f487a0935ee0c385fa9e1bf33dd68e0a36fbcbef.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35627366/e70292f005b6d624daf329191fe6b0609cb8737f.gif[/img]

[b]**Local Filmer Mode**[/b]
It's time to make friends and make some skate footage with the new Local Filmer Mode!  With an additional controller or using Steam Remote-play-together, a second player can take control of a second camera and then watch what you've filmed in the replay editor!

You can try this out by going to the Experimental / Local Filmer Mode menu!

notes.title: Hotfix Early Access v0.0.0.1b
notes.content:
[b]Hotfix Early Access v0.0.0.1b[/b]

Sup everyone! 

While we’ve been heads down working on the Xbox One version for the past couple weeks, this hasn't kept the team from working on bugs, crashes, fixes, polish and overall optimisation among other things. 

We have gathered feedback and issues you've encountered in the forums and messages we received and came up with our second of many more Hotfixes to come :)

Thanks a lot for your feedback and do no hesitate to give us more. We hope these fixes will help you with some of the issues you've encountered and will make you appreciate the game a little more!  ;)

We've highlighted the main issues we fixed / worked on, along with many other small things that have been done that weren't worth mentioning, but should nonetheless help with the overall experience too.

Below is an overview of the more important issues we fixed / worked on in the game for this update. 

[b]Montage Tool [/b]

With this update, we fixed a number of issues and crashes within the Montage Tool and added a new camera playback mode to help when keying camera angles.


[b]Skating Experience[/b]

- Push strength has been increased. 

- Near Camera position has been slightly adjusted.

- On a general note, several flip trick’s have been reworked and corrected for all stances. 

- Grind connectivity has been tweaked to ease the alignment.

- Rotations have been smoothed out and should now be easier to 180 consistently.

- Respawn (after bailing on a grind) close camera bug has been fixed. 

- Reverts can now be adjusted/deactivated from the Options / Gameplay Menu

- Goofy (Reg’s Switch) Smith/Feeble and Willy/Over Willy are now working as designed.

[b]Art[/b]

- General performance should feel better/smoother and some FPS gain should be noticed

- Optimisation has been made to reduce the GPU usage. 

- Overall city collision fixes. 

- Overall art optimisation.

- Night light has been improved

- Shadow distance and cascade have been optimised.

[b]Developer note:[/b]

[i]Manual catch state and manual trick catch Issues[/i]

In its current state, Manual and Automatic catch modes are sharing the same database. 
In order to fix the ‘’manual catch late shuv bug’’ and to make the development of the feature more efficient, we decided to separate both databases and give manual mode its own. This way, it will be much easier to work on manual catch mode without impacting the results of the automatic one.  This implies bigger changes than a singular bug fix, forcing us to keep a working automatic catch treflip at the expense of a broken manual flip tricks for the moment.  Basically, the ‘’manual catch late shuv bug’’ won't be fixed with this patch. We thank you for your patience! With this new method, it will give us the necessary freedom to make both tricks modes shine as much as possible.


Thanks and more to come!

notes.title: Hotfix Early Access v0.0.0.1a
notes.content:
Hey homies, 

First and foremost!

[b]Thanks EVERYONE[/b] for supporting us over Early Access! 

So far, reception is great and we are definitely excited to start this journey with you guys! 

As you might know, crea-ture is formed of 6 extremely devoted developers. 
Yesterday was a big day for us and we already knew by the fact we are a small team, strange and nasty bugs that we never encountered during dev would happen.

As of day one, we quickly found that a lot of you had issues with Reverts and more than we expected are on Windows 7.


[b]1. Mannequin shader Issue[/b]

Through watching user videos, we found (even though it wasn't breaking the experience) the presence of a weird super pale skin shader and shadow oily stains bugs in Epic Mode.


[b]2. Windows 7 fix[/b]

Even though Windows 7 wasn't part of the minimal requirements, we still wanted to try our best fixing it so you guys can enjoy SESSION as too. 

So with this Hotfix, Windows 7 users should now be able to play. 

***One important note to keep in mind*** Since Microsoft announced that Windows 7 will become officially an unsupported platform in January 2020 could with the fact we have upcoming features that includes Third Party tools only supporting Windows 8+,  we may not be able to support this platform as efficiently in the future.

[b]Reverts[/b]

Reverts should now be a little easier on lower frame rates.   This should help using the revert feature and complete the Tutorial.
We may still have to work on that particular issue as it seems to be also bound to different/untested controller hardware. Thanks for letting us know regarding that subject.


[b]GPU Crash[/b]

Another issue we are looking at is the GPU crash. 
Unfortunately, this is a pretty bad one and not related to the actual game but to some particular configuration of different video cards and unreal engine core. 

We found out overclocked computers often have this issue (diagnosed on several other Unreal Engine based games) or caused by outdated video cards. 

Until we find a solution, we invite you to limit your frame rate in the options and if it isn't enough, lower the dynamic shadow quality as they seem to be the bottle neck in most situations. Since the game is currently 100% dynamic lighting, it is definitely more demanding on the GPU.

Lots of optimizing in progress since we are also hard at work trying to get Session in the hands of Xbox One players for XGP as soon as possible as we promised, so stay tuned.  But, don't worry we are still working in parallel on the Steam version fixing bugs, etc. 

Also, we are currently working on making our road map more accessible and will be sharing that with you soon!


MASSIVE THANKS from the entire crea-ture Team!

Cheers  and have a great sesh!
